description: Delete a spec template by id (GUID) or name. Soft: it disappears from list_spec_templates and apply_spec_fill can no longer use it. Items already filled from it keep their values, and those fills can still be reversed; the preview counts them. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential and an Admin user.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

template.description: The template to delete: its id (GUID) or name.

name: delete_spec_template
title: Delete Spec Template
